run_explorer_grid: run the explorer function to launch a grid of CLIP-conv experiments across multiple seeds and audio datasets on SLURM
configure_slurm_jobs: configure SLURM job settings with launcher.slurm_ specifying GPUs, memory, partition, and hardware constraints
bind_experiment_params: bind experiment parameters like model type, dataset selections, and feature representations using launcher.bind
launch_feature_variations: launch experiment variations with different speech features like MelSpectrum and DeepMel using sub calls
compute_noise_baseline: compute a noise level baseline experiment by setting max_batches to 1 and enabling test.wer_random
